Frequently Asked Questions

Transparent AI evaluation & resume analysis

How is my mock interview score calculated?

After you submit all 10 answers, each response is evaluated using our weighted AI rubric: Semantic Relevance (50%), Technical Correctness (20%), Completeness (15%), Clarity (10%), and Practical Application (5%). Overall Score = Sum of all 10 question scores / 10 (max 100), with 70% as the default RECOMMENDED readiness threshold.

Can I view the correct answers during or after an interview?

Reference answers, scores, and AI feedback stay strictly locked during the live session. Immediately after clicking Final Submit Interview, every question displays your answer, weighted score breakdown, correct reference answer, detailed explanation, missing concepts, and improvement tips — saved permanently in Interview History.

Does an above-average score guarantee a job offer?

No. All interview scores and ATS estimates are AI-based practice assessments designed to guide your preparation, not official employer hiring decisions.

What resume formats are supported?

PDF, DOCX, and TXT files up to 5 MB with binary signature and MIME validation. Scanned image-only PDFs are clearly flagged if readable text cannot be extracted.
